kind_why: A combat surf map: small, built to fight on rather than to time (see notes). 'arena' keeps it out of g2gfast's rotation, vote and nominations -- it stays installed, loadable with `map`, and listed on M as combat -- and marks it for game-arena's deathmatch.
author: xblah
notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones: a combat surf map with no finish (see maps/zones/README.md). Spawn rooms with weapon stashes behind func_doors (elites, M3s, MAC-10s, scouts, AWPs), and every trigger_teleport sends a player back to a spawn, the prison or the cliff top -- a loop, not a route. gb-maps-1. Not published.
